column3: Kuroneko Route · Overworking, Lack of Sleep and Anxiety
Although I can only perform a simple medical examination here, this is just a simple case of overwork and lack of sleep.
Whew... That's good to hear...
Well then, I will be leaving for a while, let me know when she comes around, all right?
That's what the doctor said, Kuroneko.
It looks like Kuroneko... isn't going to be waking up anytime soon.
Wake up soon, I have to scold you no matter what.
Besides, this is the first time... that I'm so close to Kuroneko's face...
We haven't been this close because of the distance between us.
Her cheeks are a little red... But, it seems that she has calmed down... That's really great...
She's been sulking a lot recently...
Haha... It'll be great if her mood gets better when she wakes up.
Nnn...
Kuroneko, are you awake?
This place is...
The infirmary. Don't you remember? You collapsed all of a sudden.
...I do remember, quite clearly.
Geez... But, since you're unexpectedly full of vigor, I'm quite relieved.
Besides, it's just lack of sleep and overwork, isn't it? You don't have to be so worried.
Even if it's nothing big, if you collapse, won't it be all for nothing?
Right... Initially I thought I would be able to continue like this... I'm really worthless.
You...! Good grief, I can't handle you... You won't listen even if I say it again, right?
Of course. I'm not obliged to listen to you.
Yeah yeah... Well, I'll just say it again just for the sake of it.
In short, stop overworking yourself... I can't always come out to stop you.
...As for what happened this time, I feel that it's you who got me angry for no reason in the first place...?
Yes yes... It's my bad... Just take it as my fault then.
But you know, you should take extra care since you already collapsed once. It will be troublesome if you aren't lucky.
It's okay to make me worried. After all, it's me who's concerned for you on my own accord.
However, if you're causing the others to worry... you should stop.
It's better to avoid making everyone... sad.
...That's right... That's something I don't wish to see either.
Yeah, is that so. It makes me happy that you're willing to listen.
Well then... I'll go get the doctor here.
......Hold it.
? What is it?
